# Compute weighted loss L = tr((I - I_GT)^2) / tr(I_GT) [S1, unofficial]

The claim specifies the loss function for shape optimization as $L = tr((I - I_{GT})^2) / tr(I_{GT})$. However, the evidence in Source [S1] explicitly defines the loss function for shape optimization as a weighted L2 loss using the Frobenius inner product: $L = (I - I_{GT})^2, I_{GT}$ (where the notation implies normalization by the inner product of $I_{GT}$ with itself, i.e., $||I - I_{GT}||_F^2 / ||I_{GT}||_F^2$). While the trace of a matrix squared is related to the Frobenius norm, the claim's formula uses the trace of the squared difference matrix divided by the trace of the ground truth matrix, which is mathematically distinct from the normalized Frobenius inner product described in the text. Furthermore, the text describes it as minimizing a weighted L2 loss, not specifically the trace ratio formula provided in the claim.
